Liam: quick pulse  I kicked off the adaptive-priming + confidence-routing runs last night. need a concise econ + risk snapshot for GTN (they want per-100k and p95).
Sofia: runs finished, raw artifacts on s3: s3://redwood-experiments/adaptive-4123009876. TL;DR below.
Ben: TL;DR please (per-100k tokens, p95, and where quality regressed).
Sofia: baseline = prod 14b-int8 (our current default) -> per-100k = $10.20, p95 = 315ms, longform F1 = 0.904.
Sofia: experiment = hybrid adaptive: zephyr9b-int4 for drafts + titan14b-int6 finalize, with an online confidence model that increases priming intensity only when confidence low. net priming avg +4.3% tokens.
```
baseline per-100k = $10.20, p95 = 315ms, longform F1 = 0.904
adaptive hybrid per-100k = $6.45, p95 = 345ms, longform F1 = 0.895
priming overhead = +4.3% tokens but search recall +1.4% (short answers)
```
Claire: that's ~36.8% nominal savings. If we add finalize cost (titan finalize on ~6% of traffic) net savings ~33%.
Ben: where is the quality delta concentrated? hallucination, factuality, or structure?
Sofia: mostly coherence on multi-section summaries (>900 tokens) and slight multi-sentence factual recall drops. Extraction and short Q/A are effectively parity. Factuality regressions were rare but present on long lists.
Liam: product requires longform drop < 0.01 absolute. Can routing + adaptive priming keep us in bounds?
Ben: proposal: adaptive-length+conf routing + two-stage priming intensity:
- short (<180 tokens): zephyr9b-int4 primary (90%), no finalize unless low-conf
- mid (180-700): zephyr primary (70%), titan finalize on low-conf or on top-k semantic-diff triggers
- long (>700): titan14b-int6 primary, zephyr for fast draft for latency-sensitive clients, only finalize on low-conf
Also: confidence model adjusts priming intensity from 0% -> 12% per-request based on predicted difficulty. Warm KV cache for active sessions enabled.
Sofia: sims with that policy -> cost reduction 31-35% after finalize cost, longform F1 within 0.006 of baseline if we apply a cheap `titan-lite-rerank` to low-conf outputs.
Claire: what monitoring should GTN track?
Liam: gate with feature flag `adaptive.priming.confidence.v1`. Canary 4% -> 20% -> 50%. Rollback triggers:
- longform_F1_drop > 0.01 abs
- regen_rate > 1.5x
- p95 > 520ms
Also sample 0.15% of traffic to full-eval (human + synthetic) for 14 days.
Ben: include A/B arm for priming policy: static +8% vs adaptive (0-12%) to measure token efficiency.
Sofia: I'll add `adaptive.priming.confidence.v1.intensity_ab` as a rollout knob.
Liam: paste the routing/config snippet for ops (copyable):
```json
{
  "flag": "adaptive.priming.confidence.v1",
  "routing": [
    {"max_len": 180, "primary": "zephyr9b-int4", "fallback": "titan14b-int6", "primary_weight": 0.9},
    {"min_len": 181, "max_len": 700, "primary": "zephyr9b-int4", "fallback": "titan14b-int6", "primary_weight": 0.7},
    {"min_len": 701, "primary": "titan14b-int6", "fallback": "zephyr9b-int4", "primary_weight": 1.0}
  ],
  "priming": {"mode": "adaptive", "max_extra_tokens_pct": 12},
  "confidence_model": "online-difficulty-v2",
  "rerank_flow": "titan-lite-rerank"
}
```
ops-bot: scheduled: flag adaptive.priming.confidence.v1 -> 4% at 4123009900, healthchecks enabled.
Claire: small ask for GTN doc  include an amortized appendix by endpoint shape (search/chat/long-summarize). who can draft?
Ben: I'll do a tiny appendix: search: baseline $8.70 -> adaptive $4.95 (-43%); chat (mixed turns): baseline $10.00 -> adaptive $6.40 (-36%); long-summarize: baseline $12.50 -> adaptive $9.75 (-22% but risk of -0.009 F1 without rerank).
Sofia: added note: the adaptive path reduced unnecessary priming by ~60% compared to always-on priming, that's the main token efficiency win.
Liam: ops PR + GTN one-pager target by EOD tomorrow. Also include a short dev note on how the confidence model is calibrated and where to tune thresholds.
Ben: will include calibration curves and a small checklist: monitor `confidence_score_hist`, `per-route longform_F1`, `regen_rate`, `avg_extra_tokens_pct`.
Sofia: I'll attach the raw slices and simulation notebook to the PR.
eval-bot: scheduled: human-sample 0.15% -> nightly export to GTN review queue.
Claire: can we add a short micro-experiment after canary to test switching finalize model from titan14b-int6 to titan14b-int8 for finalize-only (higher quality, higher cost) on 0.5% traffic?
Liam: yes, add `adaptive.priming.confidence.v1.finalizer_tier` as an internal knob.
Sofia: noted. opening PR for ops now.
Liam: thanks all. closing loop on this thread. :thumbsup:
